title: Global sections over an affine base are integral for a universally closed morphism
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a universally closed morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the induced ring homomorphism $A\to H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism].
